entities.summary: Count Gustaf David Gilbert John William Hamilton was a highly decorated Swedish soldier and noble who served in the Imperial German Army during World War I and served as commander of the 3rd Cuirassiers "Count Wrangel.". Following the war, Hamilton resumed active service in the Swedish Army, reaching the rank of Colonel.
